correctness.rationale: The fixed graph and all 708 augmented faces are regenerated by an exhaustive exact check. The explicit 347 matched face pairs form an acyclic Hasse matching, leaving 5 degree-2 and 9 degree-3 cells; unpairing the empty-face pair yields a single critical vertex. The signed integral Morse matrix is exactly rank one with unit gcd; the 2-connected two-skeleton and the integral attachment maps therefore give four 2-spheres and eight 3-spheres. The complete D10 traces follow from exact rank-195 boundary-image arithmetic over both GF(101) and GF(103), uniquely lifted under Betti bounds and checked against Lefschetz identities.

The present graph is 4-regular, whereas every nonempty outerplanar graph has a vertex of degree at most two.
The published square-cycle independence complex work is for the graph itself, rather than its line graph.

originality.rationale: The accessible full primary theorem of Bayer–Jelić Milutinović–Vega applies only to outerplanar graphs; the pentagonal antiprism is four-regular, so it lies outside that theorem. The matching-complex = line-graph independence-complex equivalence was checked against cycle-power independence results. Targeted graph-alias, homotopy and symmetry searches found no antiprism-specific calculation; closest indexed matching computations are for different graphs and do not imply this exact homotopy or D10 representation. Remaining risks are acknowledged.

value.rationale: The regular pentagonal antiprism is a canonical 4-regular nonouterplanar planar polyhedral graph. An exact integral, mixed-dimensional homotopy classification supplies a mathematically motivated test instance for the planar matching-complex question, while the full D10 character is substantial symmetry data inaccessible from Betti numbers alone. No general antiprism-family extension is claimed.
